Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3414); Hieremias (i.e. Jermijah), an Israelite:--Jeremiah.
BiblicalUsage: Jeremiah is a person named 3 times in Scripture, in Matthew. The full story lives on the Jeremiah profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps Jeremiah in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
RelatedEvents: The Flight into Egypt; The Massacre of the Innocents; Peter's Confession at Caesarea Philippi
